dgoblin.name: Goblin Cutter
dgoblin.ex: Quick, mean, and it never misses twice. It never misses once, either.

potboy.name: Pot Boy
potboy.ex: It was a pot until you walked past. Spells rattle round inside it and come out the spout.

dogre.name: Crystal Ogre
dogre.ex: Arrows shatter on the crystal grown through its hide. Get close, or cast.

gull.name: Gull
gull.ex: It wants your chips. It will settle for your eye. Hangs over the water where a sword cannot follow: a bow, or a wand.

deckhand.name: Deckhand
deckhand.ex: Paid in bluefin and rum, and she has had both. Quick with the knife between the stalls.

clawhand.name: Clawhand
clawhand.ex: A pirate with a crab's claw where a hand should be. Arrows skate off the shell; it opens for a blade or a spell.

krakenarm.name: Kraken Arm
krakenarm.ex: Only the arm. Nobody has seen the rest, and nobody is fishing there to find out. Reaches two tiles from its water; mostly beyond a sword.

captainclaw.name: Captain Claw
captainclaw.ex: The claw is bigger than his other arm and he is prouder of it. Anyone who hurts him shares the kill.

yeti.name: Yeti
yeti.ex: Up on the ledges, hurling snowballs from four tiles. A wand outreaches him: 40% more from spells, less from arrows, and no sword reaches that high.

snowowl.name: Snow Owl
snowowl.ex: It never lands. No sword reaches it, arrows glance off the feathers, and a spell brings it down 70% faster than anything.

frostwolf.name: Frost Wolf
frostwolf.ex: It runs the snow in packs and comes straight at you. 40% more from spells, 25% less from arrows and swords; afraid of fire, at home in the frost.

frostwraith.name: Frost Wraith
frostwraith.ex: Ice and mist in a hood. Swords and arrows go straight through it: only a spell hurts it, 40% harder than anything else does.

iceelemental.name: Ice Elemental
iceelemental.ex: A walking heap of blue ice on the ice floes and the ledges, throwing shards from four tiles. Arrows chip it (half), spells shatter it (40% more).

frostgiant.name: Frost Giant
frostgiant.ex: Up on the Frostspire's shelves with a club of stone, throwing boulders from four tiles. 40% more from spells, 25% less from arrows, no sword reaches him.

frostjarl.name: The Frost Jarl
frostjarl.ex: The giants' king, on the high ice shelf at the top of the Frostspire. Only a spell reaches him (40% more; swords and arrows do nothing), he hurls ice six tiles, and anyone who hurts him shares the kill.

caveman.name: Caveman
caveman.ex: Wrapped in hides, up on the ledges, throwing rocks from four tiles. A bow outranges him and his hides are thin: arrows hit him 40% harder, spells 25% softer.

pterodactyl.name: Pterodactyl
pterodactyl.ex: It never lands. Out of a sword's reach entirely, and it attacks from three tiles; an arrow brings it down 70% faster than anything else.

sabretooth.name: Sabretooth
sabretooth.ex: It comes straight at you along the road, which is exactly where an arrow goes: 40% more from archery, 25% less from spells. Every animal in the valley is afraid of fire, and so is this one.

mammoth.name: Woolly Mammoth
mammoth.ex: Up on the ledges where the grass is, out of reach of anything but an arrow (40% more from archery): swords and spells do nothing to it. It kicks stones down from four tiles. That much fur shrugs off frost and fire alike.

matriarch.name: The Mammoth Matriarch
matriarch.ex: The oldest mammoth in the valley, up on the Lowlands' great plateau with her herd. Only an arrow reaches her (40% more from archery), she stamps stones down six tiles, and she shrugs off frost and fire. She comes back ev

pteroelder.name: Elder Pterodactyl
pteroelder.ex: Older, bigger and meaner, and it still never lands. No sword reaches it; an arrow brings it down 70% faster than anything.

cavehunter.name: Caveman Hunter
cavehunter.ex: A caveman who has lived long enough to stand on the highest ledge and throw straight. Rocks from four tiles; arrows 40% harder, spells 25% softer.

raptor.name: Raptor
raptor.ex: Too quick to aim a spell at (half from magic), but it runs in straight lines: arrows hit it 40% harder. They hunt in threes.

tarhorror.name: Tar Pit Horror
tarhorror.ex: Tar with bones in it. A sword sinks in and comes back out with nothing; an arrow finds the skull inside: 40% more from archery, half from spells.

rex.name: Old Rex
rex.ex: The valley's end, and its oldest thing, on his throne up on the high plateau. Only an arrow reaches him (40% more from archery; swords and spells do nothing), and he roars stones down six tiles. Anyone who hurts him shar

wasp.name: Wasp
wasp.ex: The size of a hand and angrier than that. Hangs over the water and the hives; a blade mostly fans it. Frost drops it.

orchardorc.name: Orchard Orc
orchardorc.ex: A camp orc with a staff and opinions about your walnuts. Sun magic goes through it; void it shrugs off.

orchardkeeper.name: Orchard Keeper
orchardkeeper.ex: The camp's warrior, and the trees are his. The shield turns arrows; get in close, or cast.

hedgething.name: Hedge Thing
hedgething.ex: An orc that stood in the hedge too long, or a hedge that learned to hold a spear. A blade goes into the leaves; fire is what it minds.

gardener.name: The Gardener
gardener.ex: The camp's shaman. He grew the hedge things, he grows the wasps, and he would like the orchard back. Anyone who hurts him shares the kill.

slaggolem.name: Slag Golem
slaggolem.ex: Slag that got up. Arrows chip it; a blade or a spell breaks it. Frost cracks it right open.

furnaceimp.name: Furnace Imp
furnaceimp.ex: It stokes the furnace and steals from the floor. Quick, and it bites. Frost puts it out.

cinderelemental.name: Cinder Elemental
cinderelemental.ex: A fire with a shape and a grudge. A sword goes through it; arrows and frost are what it minds.

bessemer.name: Old Bessemer
bessemer.ex: The foundry's first foreman, grown into the wall of bodies at the end of the Hall: horns, a mouth full of fire, and hands the size of a cart. He never gets up; he doesn't need to. Reaches three tiles. Anyone who hurts hi

dwisp.name: Abyss Wisp
dwisp.ex: It hangs over the drop where no sword can reach and spells pass straight through its crystal. Bring a bow.

diron.name: Iron Ogre
diron.ex: Plated in iron from the brow down. Swords ring off it, arrows bounce, and only Void magic gets through.

deepwarden.name: The Deepwarden
deepwarden.ex: The mountain's keeper. He hits like a falling ceiling and he does not tire. Bring friends.
